div.div: مُفْرِحٌ A thing that makes joyful or glad, or that makes happy: (T, L:) [and بِهِ ↓ مَفْرُوحٌ a thing by which one is made joyful or glad, or by which one is made happy:] one says, مَا يَسُرُّنِى بِهِ مُفْرِحٌ, (As, T, S, L,) and بِهِ ↓ مَفْرُوحٌ , for which one should not say مَفْرُوحٌ [alone], (As, S,) [i. e. Nothing that makes joyful &c., and by which one is made joyful &c., renders me happy by means of it,] relating to an affair, or event. (S.) [See also فُرْحَةٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
